title: Grade 5 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #9

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Gratitude? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on Gratitude has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Gratitude with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Gratitude.
   D. Use Hadith on Gratitude to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah.
   B. Apply the teaching of Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah has no place in daily life.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Destroy trees without planting

4. Which response best shows understanding of Miracles of Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Miracles of Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Miracles of Prophets.
   C. Use Miracles of Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Miracles of Prophets has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living)? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living) has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living).
   C. Apply the teaching of Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living) with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living) to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Knowledge? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Knowledge with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Knowledge.
   C. Say Hadith on Knowledge has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Hadith on Knowledge to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels.
   D. Use Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

9. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Use Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets.
   C. Apply the teaching of Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Greetings? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Greetings.
   B. Say Hadith on Greetings has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Hadith on Greetings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Greetings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Hiding stolen items

12. Which response best shows understanding of Nullifiers of Swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Nullifiers of Swalah.
   B. Say Nullifiers of Swalah has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Nullifiers of Swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Nullifiers of Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Miracles of Prophets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Nullifiers of Swalah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
